annotations.text: A · Two Doors — "the shop has two doors: for Rosie, for the Barn." Today's drop stays one mixed row; the stage under the doors follows the door. Collect. Cost: low — today's segmented control + the furnishing collection, in-tab.

B · One Aisle — "scroll the shop; things are sorted by where they go." One scroll, sectioned by spot; the pinned strip flips Rosie ↔ her Barn at the seam; TODAY is a stamp on tiles. Collect. Cost: medium — sticky-strip flip logic, section jump-links.

C · Try It On — "tap a spot on Rosie or her room, buy what fits there." Stage-first with six pins; a tapped tile hangs a ghost on your own wall before you spend. Collect + Connect. Cost: high — composes PigStage + HabitatScene, ghost placement, a drawer.

D · Market Stalls — "buy from a stall; fill the table to earn its gifts." Sets mix a hat and a rug on one table with the furnishing milestones (4 · 8). Collect. Cost: medium-high — accessories need a collection_id; mixed milestones change the economy.

Same stock on every board: 1,240-snout pocket · today's drop · Slop Club band (MEMBERS ribbon + lock) · hats & bows for Rosie · Harvest Hoedown / Orchard Morning furnishings · a snout price on every tile · Owned / Wearing / Placed / Season pass.

Tokens read from constants/theme.ts; card anatomy from app/(tabs)/shop.tsx ShopCard; sheet/chip/button/segmented from components/ui. Buttons are Nunito 800 as Button.tsx ships them. Art is the shipped art (rosie.png, warm_plank_barn, hats, habitat/expansion).
